integrity: Analytic proof of a necessary-and-sufficient classification; numerical checks are supplementary, not exhaustive certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite unidirectional scalar observation at vertex 1 of a single-defect undirected cycle, n>=5, w>0. No quantitative observability conditioning or multi-defect claim. Relevant specialty literature may contain undiscovered equivalent results.
title: Exact single-sensor observability resonances of a singly weighted cycle
